miss_rate.definition: the fraction of the reference quintessentials that NEITHER the selection nor the audit caught
miss_rate.power_note: the reference set is small, so the miss rate is a count with a wide interval, not a rate with a narrow one

teacher_dependence.definition: the fraction of judgments the system must still send to a teacher, at held referee-graded quality
teacher_dependence.why: the reader's training labels all come from the performer's own priors, and no referee has graded anything yet, so not one of its judgments is certified; the moment Casey's blind grades are in, --score-listening reports the ratio as 1 - (machine's agreement with the referee)

tone_vocabulary.alias_note: earnest is measured as 'sincere'; sarcasm has no exemplar and 'joking' is a PROXY; question has NO exemplar in this corpus at all

honesty.one_person: the baseline is one person's, from one day
honesty.classes_not_averaged: SCRIPT, DRILLED and AMBIENT are reported separately and never averaged
honesty.audit_is_exhaustive_here: the corpus is small enough that the whole routine pile was audited, so the miss rate is a count; the sample-based form is what scales
honesty.reference_is_by_construction: the reference set carries no rater's judgement: it is the only performed take in the corpus
